name: Survive 99 Nights Troll Tower
desc:
🎉 Welcome to Survive 99 Nights Troll Tower - Ready to endure the tower’s trolls, obstacles, and nonstop slaps?
🌙 Hide from the Monsters when it turns night, and get a reward for each night you survive!

How to Play
👊Avoid troll traps and slaps from other players.
🏆 Make it to the top to collect Cash, an OP Slap Hand, and a Flying Carpet.
😂 Equip Troll Tools to smack friends and rivals straight into the void.
🛒 Spend Cash on upgraded Troll Tools and HD Admin — everything you buy is saved.
🎁 At the top, watch for the Lucky Block and Void Slap for extra EXCLUSIVE rewards.
💯 Finish lobby towers to unlock an invisibility cloak and an ABILITY Slap.

💻 Works on Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet. Purchases and Admin save automatically.

✔️Premium Benefits: +5 Walkspeed to reach the top quicker.
